title: Configured Jira space permits domain preflight but not issue mutation
input: A project context declares Jira space key CMW (CM Wizard). Aaron asks to create an issue in CMW. Return only execution-decision.md with headings ## Decision, ## Next action, and ## Boundary. Do not call Jira or create an issue.

rubric.label: Names the configured Jira space key
Allows the guarded domain workflow after verification
Boundary keeps the Jira target declared rather than inferred
Boundary leaves issue mutation to the domain workflow
